discussion_comments.comment_body: `applyFunctionOffsets` only visits params and body, so the compiled function node has no `start`/`end`. `createNewFunctionNode` in `Entrypoint/Program.ts` (lines 277, 289, 303) copies `loc` but not the offsets. Rust does set them, so the backends differ on these nodes, and span consumers use them too. Could `createNewFunctionNode` also copy `start` and `end` from `originalFn.node`?
